# DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM

This Data Processing Addendum ("DPA") forms part of the Master Subscription Agreement between Meridian Analytics, Inc. ("Provider") and the customer identified in the applicable Order Form ("Customer") and reflects the parties' agreement with regard to the Processing of Personal Data.

## 1. Definitions

"Personal Data" means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person that is submitted by Customer to the Services. "Processing", "Controller", "Processor", "Data Subject", and "Supervisory Authority" have the meanings given in the GDPR.

## 2. Roles and Scope

2.1 Customer is the Controller and Provider is the Processor with respect to Personal Data processed under the Agreement.

2.2 Provider shall Process Personal Data only in accordance with Customer's documented instructions, except that Provider may Process Personal Data as required by applicable law, and may use Personal Data, in aggregated and de-identified form, to improve, develop, and enhance Provider's products and services and to develop new products and services, including training of statistical and machine-learning models.

## 3. Subprocessors

3.1 Customer provides a general authorization for Provider to engage Subprocessors. A current list is available at Provider's website. Provider will update the list at least ten (10) days before the addition of a new Subprocessor takes effect.

3.2 If Customer objects to a new Subprocessor on reasonable data-protection grounds, Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to offer an alternative. If no alternative is available, Provider may nonetheless proceed with the engagement, and Customer's sole remedy shall be to terminate the affected Services upon ninety (90) days' written notice, without refund of prepaid fees.

## 4. Security

4.1 Provider shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures as described in Provider's then-current security documentation, which Provider may update from time to time, provided such updates do not materially decrease the overall security of the Services.

## 5. Personal Data Breach

5.1 Provider shall notify Customer without undue delay, and in any event within seventy-two (72) hours, after becoming aware of a Personal Data Breach affecting Customer Personal Data. Provider's notification obligation shall not apply to unsuccessful security incidents.

## 6. Audits

6.1 Provider shall make available to Customer information reasonably necessary to demonstrate compliance with this DPA. Customer's audit rights shall be satisfied by Provider providing (i) a copy of Provider's then-current SOC 2 Type II report, and (ii) written responses to reasonable security questionnaires no more than once per twelve (12) month period. On-site audits are not permitted.

## 7. Data Subject Requests

7.1 Provider shall, taking into account the nature of the Processing, provide reasonable assistance to Customer for the fulfilment of Customer's obligation to respond to Data Subject requests. Such assistance shall be at Customer's expense at Provider's then-current professional services rates.

## 8. International Transfers

8.1 Provider may transfer Personal Data to any country in which Provider or its Subprocessors maintain facilities. To the extent required, the parties agree that the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Module Two) are incorporated by reference.

## 9. Return and Deletion

9.1 Upon termination of the Agreement, Provider shall, at Customer's election, return or delete Customer Personal Data within one hundred eighty (180) days, except that Provider may retain Personal Data in routine backups until such backups are recycled in the ordinary course, and may retain aggregated and de-identified data indefinitely.

## 10. Liability

10.1 Each party's liability arising out of or related to this DPA is subject to the limitations of liability set forth in the Agreement, and in no event shall Provider's aggregate liability arising out of this DPA exceed the fees paid by Customer in the three (3) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
